up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL1422 (SITAGLIPTIN) and all its salt/derivative forms. Use the molecule_hierarchy table to find all related compounds by joining molecule_dictionary (where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422') to molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno, then joining back to molecule_dictionary for the child molregno. Filter the results to only include activities against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4) where the standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units are 'nM'. Return exactly these columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (from compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (use COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi)), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (all from activities), target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), and target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT
  fam_md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = md.molregno OR mh.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary fam_md ON fam_md.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = fam_md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.record_id = a.record_id
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id AND a.molregno = fam_md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
